_: cp show.config.example.json show.config.json, then edit. Keys starting with _ are notes and never reach the feed.
title: The Example Show
_title: Apple and Spotify title search is keyword-literal, so a keyword in the title is worth real discovery. A pure brand name is cleaner but has to earn its searches. Check for collisions before you commit: a show that already owns your name owns your brand search too.
description: Straight answers about <your subject>, from <who you are>. Two to three minutes an episode.
author: Your Company
_email: Spotify sends the ownership-verification code here. It must be an inbox a human reads.
_link: The show's HUB page, not your homepage. Apple renders this as the show website and every directory links to it.
_categories: Apple allows up to three, and only from its own taxonomy. Verify the exact strings against Apple's current list; it changes.
_feedUrl: MUST equal the URL you submit. It becomes <atom:link rel="self"> and Apple follows it as canonical. Stale after a host move, Podcasts Connect fails with only 'An error has occurred.'
_image: 1400-3000px square, JPEG or PNG, RGB. Version the FILENAME on every change: Apple caches artwork by filename and a CDN will keep serving the old object even after you overwrite the key.
_host: r2 | bunny | s3 | local. The feed URL is a one-way door, so pick a host on your own domain now rather than migrating later.

tts._upgrade: Change provider to "elevenlabs" and set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY + ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID in .env when you want it to sound like a person. Or "command"/"openai" for a local model of your own. See README.

_ttsProviders: elevenlabs (hosted) | local (piper or macOS say) | command (ANY local TTS with a CLI: set tts.command with {{text_file}} and {{out}} placeholders, plus outputFormat) | openai (ANY OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech server: set baseUrl, model, voice). See README.
_ttsLicense: If you use a local model commercially, check its license. Kokoro is Apache-2.0 and Piper and Chatterbox are MIT; XTTS v2 (CPML) and F5-TTS (CC-BY-NC) are non-commercial.
_tts: eleven_v3 sounds better in isolation but rejects previous_text/next_text, and this pipeline chunks per paragraph, so v3 restarts cold at every join and a cloned voice audibly drifts. Continuity beats per-chunk polish once you are chunking.
_wpm: Spoken words per minute for the runtime estimate in --dry-run. Measured per voice; generate.mjs prints the real figure after each render so you can correct it.

episode.cta: We're <company>, <what you do> in <where>. If you want a straight answer on <thing>, we're at example.com.

_episode: Read by the writing step, not by any script. See AGENTS.md.
